scope: Save options and return to your task.

topics.title: Clear dialog names
details: Open a category in Options to hear its name and the word dialog. For example, you hear Verbosity dialog.

topics.title: Save and leave Options
details: Press Enter in a setting or choose OK to save. You hear Options saved. The Options window closes and you return to your last task.
If a setting cannot be saved, Options stays open so you can fix it. Cancel still keeps your earlier choices.

topics.title: Fewer web options
details: List website favorites is no longer in Web browser options. Your saved sites are still in the web browser menu.
